title: Sempra Completes Sale of 45% Equity Interest in Sempra Infrastructure Partners
summary: SAN DIEGO, Nov. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Sempra decisions, disallowances or denials of cost recovery, audits, investigations, inquiries, ordered studies, regulations
body_markdown:
SAN DIEGO


, Nov. 12, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Sempra (NYSE: SRE) today announced the successful close of its previously announced sale of a 45% equity interest in Sempra Infrastructure Partners (SI Partners) to affiliates of KKR, a leading global investment firm, with indirect co-investor Canada Pension Plan Investment Board.


"This marks an exciting milestone at Sempra," said Jeffrey W. Martin, chairman and CEO of Sempra. "This transaction supports our efforts to further simplify the company's business model while supporting the growth of our utilities in Texas and California."


SI Partners is one of North America's leading energy infrastructure platforms, with a portfolio of LNG export and related infrastructure assets and strong industry partnerships, positioned to help meet growing global energy demand and advance energy security. Under the terms of the transaction, the KKR-led consortium now holds a 65% ownership interest in SI Partners. Sempra retains a 25% interest, alongside an affiliate of Abu Dhabi Investment Authority's existing 10% ownership stake.


The closing of the sale of this equity stake in SI Partners follows the recent sale of Ecogas México, S. de R.L. de C.V. in August. In combination, these transactions further Sempra's capital recycling program with a view toward simplifying the company's business model, strengthening its financial position and supporting long-term utility growth in Texas and California.


Sempra is well-positioned to continue executing its strategy to strengthen its presence in major economic markets and focus its resources on meeting the growing needs of its Texas and California utilities. This approach supports continued investment in modernizing and expanding critical energy infrastructure while helping power America's growing economy.


Additional information about the closing of the transaction is addressed in Sempra's filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission, including a current report on Form 8-K filed today.


**About Sempra**
Sempra's mission is to build America's leading utility growth business. As owner of one of the largest energy networks on the continent, Sempra is electrifying and improving energy resilience in California and Texas, the two largest economies in the U.S. The company is recognized as a leader in responsible business practices and for its high-performance culture focused on safety and operational excellence, as demonstrated by Sempra's inclusion in The Wall Street Journal's Management Top 250 and Fortune's World's Most Admired Companies.
